mechanism: Phenobarbital induces CYP3A4 and glucuronidation pathways, potentially increasing chlorthalidone metabolism and reducing its diuretic efficacy; additionally, both drugs can cause hypokalemia and electrolyte disturbances.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes (potassium, sodium) and blood pressure regularly; consider alternative antiepileptic agents if possible or adjust chlorthalidone dose based on clinical response and electrolyte levels.
